'''SD Tyrant Cloud City Occupation''' is a [[Dark]] deck by SD Tyrant, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds54.htm Cloud City Occupation], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040909084137/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds54.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
